Amphetamine Bliss
I was prescribed adderall 2 years ago and had not been using it recreationally for awhile, I was prescribed 15 mg but usually took 2. The month before I had gone cold turkey to see if I would experience withdrawels and did not.
I started back up and I was a week into it. I didn't think about it but I decided to buy some kava kava and try it. I took adderall in the morning and without realizing it about 9 a.m., 3 hours after I took the adderall I popped 900 mg of kavalactones.
It started out with a mild buzz
10 minutes later somewhat marijuana-like
30 minutes into it I couldn't focus my eyes for a second and when I looked into the mirror I saw my eye dilating and contracting rapidly.
After an hour I was just laying on my bed unable or just too lazy to move but I felt awake, asleep and totally fucked up at the same time and this is when I started to feel orgasmic all over.
After 2 hours I had completely blacked out and woke up at the same time I had taken my adderall, 6:00 A.M.
In conclusion: LOVED IT
